reviews.text: The staff of this animal hospital sincerely care about the welfare of animals - Not just pampered pets!

It was fine when Dr. Saito and his heavily pregnant wife were working together at the reception desk, but ever since they added part-time doctors, veterinary nurses, and more equipment,
the number of unnecessary tests increased drastically, and I switched to another clinic. I understand they want to make money, but X-rays expose you to radiation.

My cat with kidney disease has recently been receiving care here. While it's understandable that animal medical expenses are high, I think this hospital is very reasonable. It's clear that every doctor and staff member puts the animals first. They listen carefully to what we have to say and offer various suggestions, so I feel at ease every time I bring my cat here. I'm so glad we chose this hospital.


Postscript: My cat passed away recently. They did their best, and my cat was able to spend her last moments peacefully. Thank you so much. I'm especially grateful to Dr. Ueda and Dr. Mimura. When I met the head veterinarian once, he gave me a very clear explanation. This is a truly wonderful hospital that cares deeply for animals. Thank you also for the beautiful flowers. If I have the opportunity, I would like to use their services again someday.

A pet's final moments depend on the veterinarian's character. In my case, I was treated cruelly at the end. When I consulted other hospitals, I found out they were lying a lot. At the end, they made the nurse leave the room and then harassed my pet.

I have been receiving your care for over ten years. A health checkup revealed an illness and they performed surgery. My children have now crossed the Rainbow Bridge, but I was happy to have met the doctors and staff at this hospital. I am truly grateful. Thank you very much. Health checkups are important.
Thank you for always providing thorough examinations and explanations.
The examination room is spacious, so I felt it was easy to bring even large dogs. The doctor was kind and explained things thoroughly. It's a conscientious animal hospital.

When my dog ​​vomited, they made time to treat him carefully, even though it was a busy time in the evening.

The nurses and doctors were all so kind, and I felt their love for animals, which put me at ease.

I was also touched that they called the day after the appointment to ask, "How is he doing?"

Thanks to them, my dog ​​has been fine ever since. Thank you so much!

We have two cats receiving care here.

The veterinarians are very kind ✨
They treat our cats not just as "pets," but as "family," and examine them with genuine care ✨
It's a really great hospital ✨
My cat's eyes started having more discharge and its eyes were opening less, so I took it to the vet. They suspected herpes. …

I can't go into details, but I don't recommend treating illnesses there. Vaccinations and ear cleaning might be okay, though. No matter how gentle and careful you are, there's nothing you can do if it's a misdiagnosis, and in the end, …
